notes.title: Champion of the day [OPEN BETA]
notes.content:
Let me introduce new game mode: [b]Champion of the day[/b]
- The mode is in open Beta testing.
- To participate in the game mode, you need to select Gen 8 vehicle and click "Champion of the day" in the "Other game modes" tab.
- The mode happens [b]once a day[/b], always at [b]8 p.m. CET[/b]; you can see the countdown when you select the mode.
- The game consists of 10 min qualifying and about 10 min race.
- Once the game mode starts, you don't need to click anything; just wait and race.
- Gold [b]WILL[/b] be awarded once the game mode is [b]tested[/b].

Please keep in mind that the mode is still in the testing, so make sure to report any bugs or any ideas for improvement. Also, keep in mind that the release of this mode was a little bit rushed to introduce all features of Engine Evolution 2022 early and have more time to debug them.

notes.title: NEW NATURE RENDERER
notes.content:
In my previous game, I used an asset called Vegetation Studio pro. It was good, but buggy as hell and often painful to work with. So I decided to implement new spawning and rendering system for my nature. The rendering part is handled by the GPU instancer, which culls all instances that are not visible and has brilliant performance, and is also easy to use.

The first step in spawning nature was to realize that further parts of the track don't need as much attention as the surroundings of the track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314938/3019f78bf6a6338506ebb932bd2ce33a54f47d0f.png[/img]

I realized that I can really populate the first 20 m from the track and nature feels dense as hell. The count of all instances was still nice so performance is good as well.

notes.title: COLLISIONS TEST 1
notes.content:
It happened to all of us... You are chasing somebody for the win and then he crashes you out and lose everything! NO!!! THAT'S NOT FAIR!!!

I have thought about several options and one of them is turning collisions off. So I have implemented the feature and in COLLISIONS TEST 1 we will test this feature to the fullest! During the COLLISIONS TEST, every race will have randomly turned collisions on and off (with a 50:50 chance). Do now worry, you will be able to see the difference between the modes! When collisions are turned off, other players are transparent/ghosts.

You will be able to review the feature after event here: https://forms.gle/SVpcCu9vXUfMbfNk8 Or you can discuss the feature on game's [url=https://discord.gg/nQD2UHZmtX]Discord[/url].
